documents.name: returns.md
documents.heading: Rückgaberecht
documents.text: Kunden können Produkte innerhalb von dreißig Tagen zurückgeben und erhalten eine vollständige Rückerstattung.

documents.name: warranty.md
documents.heading: Garanzia
documents.text: Tutti i prodotti hanno una garanzia di ventiquattro mesi dalla consegna. Ripariamo gratuitamente i difetti di fabbricazione.

documents.name: shipping.md
documents.heading: Envíos nacionales
documents.text: Los pedidos nacionales llegan en tres a cinco días laborables. El seguimiento del envío se manda por correo electrónico.

documents.name: payments.md
documents.heading: Payment terms
documents.text: Business invoices are payable within thirty days of the invoice date. We accept bank transfers and credit cards.

documents.name: bulk.md
documents.heading: Minimum order
documents.text: The minimum wholesale order is twelve units. Sample orders can contain a single unit.

documents.name: support.md
documents.heading: Assistance
documents.text: Notre assistance est disponible du lundi au vendredi, de neuf heures à dix-sept heures UTC.

documents.name: pricing.md
documents.heading: Volume discounts
documents.text: Orders of at least one hundred units receive a ten percent volume discount. Smaller orders use the published list price.

documents.name: ax4401.md
documents.heading: AX-4401 specifications
documents.text: The AX-4401 portable scanner has eight hours of battery life and weighs two hundred grams.

documents.name: ax4410.md
documents.heading: AX-4410 specifications
documents.text: The AX-4410 portable scanner has forty-eight hours of battery life and weighs three hundred grams.

documents.name: delta-basic.md
documents.heading: Delta Basic specifications
documents.text: The Delta Basic mixer has a five hundred watt motor and a two litre bowl.

documents.name: delta-pro.md
documents.heading: Delta Pro specifications
documents.text: The Delta Pro mixer has a seven hundred and fifty watt motor and a five litre bowl.

documents.name: international.md
documents.heading: Spedizioni internazionali
documents.text: Per gli ordini internazionali si applica Incoterms DAP. Il cliente paga eventuali dazi doganali e tasse di importazione.
